mapper.select: select f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Inv_Fund_Release mn left join SYS_File f on f.FileId = mn.Ifr_Id where mn.Ifr_Id = #{ifrId}

select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, proc.C_Name as pConsName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompDepName, ipp.* from Inv_Project_Plan ipp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = ipp.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department where ipp.Ifr_Id = #{ifrId}
